posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: #BlueJays win, 6-5. If it weren’t for Kazuma Okamoto this season… whew. They’re 78-82.
posts.jp: ブルージェイズが6-5で勝利。岡本和真がいなかったら…。78勝82敗。

posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: That's Kazuma Okamoto's 90th RBI of the season on a double into the left-field corner. Really impressive MLB debut for him. Andrés Giménez is 2nd on the team... with 58. #BlueJays
posts.jp: 岡本和真が左翼隅への二塁打で90打点目。MLBデビューとしてはほんとに素晴らしい。アンドレス・ヒメネスは58打点で2位。#ブルージェイズ

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Cubs' Pete Crow-Armstrong had the 3rd-best selling MLB jersey this season, dating to opening day, based on sales of Nike jerseys from Fanatics sites. Shohei Ohtani and Aaron Judge had the top 2 most popular jerseys.
posts.jp: Cubs's Pete Crow-Armstrongのユニフォームが今季のMLB販売数3位。大谷翔平とアーロン・ジャッジが1、2位。

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.text: The Orioles are 79-82, guaranteed of a losing season. If that's all ... thank you so much for following

reply_texts.text: Thanks everyone for your very kind words. They really do mean a lot. This job is nothing without readers
reply_texts.author: afkostka.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Thank you, Andy, for doing a good job covering the team and for being active on here and keeping us informed without having to go to the other place. I truly appreciate you.
reply_texts.author: lizzierie.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: thank you for covering, andy. you're a key resource for us on here and i want you to know that we all value you.
reply_texts.author: etgoch.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Thank you for everything, Andy. We fans are so lucky to have you!
reply_texts.author: kimschuss.bsky.social

posts.jp: オリオールズが79勝82敗で負け越し確定。これ以上言うことはありません。ご視聴ありがとう。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: Rays 2, Phillies 0. The Phillies have scored two runs in their last three games. They have homered once in their last 55 innings. They are teetering. Bullpen game on national TV tomorrow night during a nor'easter.

reply_texts.text: Sunday’s “Fan Appreciation Game” will be ugly, ugly, ugly. And guess who has tickets.
reply_texts.author: agbixler.bsky.social

reply_texts.text:
Fan Appreciation Day on Sunday. 

Will be wild.
reply_texts.author: johnmlatimer.bsky.social

posts.jp: ライズ2、フィリーズ0。フィリーズは過去3試合で2点。過去55イニングで本塁打1本。ぐらついている。明夜、全国放送のブルペンゲーム。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: The Phillies, who are making it much harder on themselves, have lost again. They might have lost Luis Arraez too. Those who stayed until the end are booing. The vibes are not great.
posts.jp: 自分たちで難しくしているフィリーズが負けた。ルイス・アライエスまで失った可能性。最後まで見てた人はブーイング。雰囲気が最悪だ。

posts.author: Adam McCalvy
posts.text: Brewers 8, Cardinals 4. Win No. 101 guarantees the Brewers will finish with sole possession of the best record in baseball for the second straight season.
posts.jp: ブルワーズ8、カージナルス4。101勝目でブルワーズ、2年連続でMLB最高勝率が確定した。
